title: Tide Fieldbook
subtitle: Perigee
intro: A record of tide basins, brines, lenses and the moons that pull on them.

entries.title: Tide Basin
entries.subtitle: Brine and Salt
facts: A water bucket fills an empty Tide Basin. It needs open sky above it.
Over half a night the water condenses into brine of the tide that night. Each fill gives 3 bottles.
Brine left in the basin through the next day dries into Phase Salt.
entries.flavour: Still water, held up to the moon.

entries.title: Lenses
entries.subtitle: Tidal Stand
facts: A Blank Lens on a Tidal Stand turns into that tide's lens after 4 bottles of one brine.
8 more bottles of the same brine fix a lens so it works at full strength every night.
entries.flavour: Glass remembers the night it was poured.

entries.title: Phase Medallion
entries.subtitle: Necklace
facts: Worn in the necklace slot. Hold a lens in the other hand and use the medallion to set it.
A Full lens walks on water, a Waxing lens draws items and XP in, a New lens hides in shadow and a Waning lens spreads damage over a few seconds.
A lens is strongest on its own tide's nights and fades as the moon moves on.

entries.title: Tide Dial
entries.subtitle: Redstone
facts: No signal by day. At night the signal follows the pull of the moon phase.
Full power on a special moon.
entries.flavour: The pull, read off a dial.

entries.title: The Perigee Moon
entries.subtitle: Rare full moon
facts: Rises only on some full moons. Basins condense twice as fast.
Basins make Perigee Brine. Its lens holds all four tide powers at half strength, every night.

entries.title: Other Moons
entries.subtitle: Fundamentum, Ostentum, Ars Moriendi
facts: Each special moon gives its own brine, and that brine makes its own lens.
Moon lenses work at full strength every night.
entries.flavour: Every strange moon leaves its own salt.
